notablePrerequisites:
Cayth does not have summoning sickness.
Crystalline Crawler and Cryptic Trilobite each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Cayth.
description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Cayth.
Repeat.
